title: Daily Coffee & Snack Spend Creep
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn category=coffee_snacks
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(amount) as spend, count as buys by _time
| sort - _time
description: Adds up the small coffee and snack purchases that quietly total a fortune over a month.
value: The daily latte factor is invisible transaction by transaction; a weekly total makes the real cost impossible to ignore.
implementation: Categorise transactions in `index=personal`; schedule weekly and total the small everyday buys.
visualization: Column chart of weekly coffee and snack spend.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up all your little coffee and snack buys, which quietly cost a surprising amount each month.
